comparison.objective: Slide a monitor out, attach a clip-on light bar, then return the monitor to its starting location; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual bulky-object sliding, clip alignment/attachment, and restoration under shelf clearance versus small-tool alignment, collar adjustment, counterholding, locking, and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Light bar fitted and monitor returned; positional tolerance, clip engagement test, damage limits, and hold time are absent. Candidate requires explicit energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, and drift gates.
comparison.reason: Clearance management and clip-on accessory installation do not exercise iterative damping adjustment or setting retention.
